scope: Bounded read-only queries, each with its own snapshot; not a single database-wide snapshot.

identity.sql: SELECT current_database(),current_user,version(),current_setting('port') AS port,current_setting('server_encoding') AS encoding,current_setting('transaction_read_only') AS read_only,pg_size_pretty(pg_database_size(current_database())) AS database_size

rows.version: PostgreSQL 18.4 (Ubuntu 18.4-1.pgdg22.04+1) on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Ubuntu 11.4.0-1ubuntu1~22.04.3) 11.4.0, 64-bit

relations.sql: SELECT n.nspname AS schema,c.relname,c.relkind,c.reltuples::bigint AS estimated_rows,pg_total_relation_size(c.oid) AS total_bytes,obj_description(c.oid) AS description FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('public','analysis','wiki_relations') AND c.relkind IN ('r','p','m','v') ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname

rows.description: Block intervals replayed from logging log_type=block. [start_ts, end_ts): end = min(scheduled expiry, next reblock, unblock). expiry_ts=infinity for indefinite blocks; NULL expiry only for pre-2005 rows without params. sitewide=false rows are partial (page/namespace-scoped) blocks: do not remove those editors from the global risk set. Range blocks (is_range) and autoblock ids (#nnn) have no actor.

Revisions of the sampled page-windows (sql/21_edit_event.sql): article (ns 0) and talk (ns 1) rows over [pull_start, pull_end) of sample_page_<mode>, plus one seed row per page before pull_start (in_range = false). section = /* Section */ autocomment, talk rows only. Revert flags: sql/22_revert_tags.sql.

Revisions of the sampled page-windows (sql/21_edit_event.sql): article (ns 0) and talk (ns 1) rows over [pull_start, pull_end) of sample_page_<mode>, plus one seed row per page before pull_start (in_range = false). section = /* Section */ autocomment, talk rows only. Revert flags: sql/22_revert_tags.sql.

Global per-actor edit history from the 2026-04-01 revision dump (DuckDB over data/raw/revision Parquet). Timestamps UTC. ts_Nth_edit = timestamp of the actor's N-th surviving edit, all namespaces. Only actors with n_edits_total >= min_edits (see analysis.editor_history_meta) are loaded.

Per-actor status timeline; one row per actor with >= min_edits surviving edits (analysis.editor_history_meta). Timestamps UTC. registration_ts from the newusers log, else first edit (registration_source). autoconfirmed_ts = max(reg+4d, 10th surviving edit), NULL if never reached (dump lacks deleted edits: fuzzy for 8-12-edit accounts); autoconfirmed_pre2008_ts = reg+4d under the pre-May-2008 rule. extendedconfirmed_ts = first EC grant in the rights log (exact; sysops are implicitly EC: use sysop_from_ts); ec_rule_ts = rule-based 30d+500 edits for cross-checks, NULL below 500 edits. NULL start with *_unlogged = true means held before the log; sysop_end_unlogged = removal not logged on enwiki.
Neighbour candidates of sample_page_full (python/export_neighbours.py select: seed 20260930, k_cand 40, hub cap n_in <= 20000); sql/23_neighbour_page.sql picks K per (window, direction).
Neighbour candidates of sample_page_smoke (python/export_neighbours.py select: seed 20260930, k_cand 40, hub cap n_in <= 20000); sql/23_neighbour_page.sql picks K per (window, direction).

Article revisions of the neighbour pages (sql/24_neighbour_event.sql): [pull_start, pull_end) of each segment of neighbour_pull_<mode> plus one seed row per segment before pull_start (in_range = false). Revert flags from the sha1 rule only (no change_tag pass): is_revert = is_revert_sha1, was_reverted = was_reverted_sha1.

Revert flags from the sha1 rule only (no change_tag pass): is_revert = is_revert_sha1, was_reverted = was_reverted_sha1.

Neighbour pages of sample_page_<mode> (sql/23_neighbour_page.sql): up to k_used out-link and k_used in-link neighbours per window from the current link graph (article_neighbours.parquet), seeded-hash order, excluding sampled pages, redirects, hubs (> 20k in-links) and pages with < min_edits revisions in the year before pull_start. direction = out: the focal page links to the neighbour; in: the neighbour links to the focal page. pull_id -> neighbour_pull_<mode>, the merged revision-pull segment of the neighbour page.

Merged [pull_start, pull_end) segments per distinct neighbour page of neighbour_page_<mode> (sql/23): one LATERAL revision pull each in sql/24_neighbour_event.sql. n_windows = windows sharing the segment.

WikiProject-banner topic proxy (python/wikiproject_topic.py; halfak 2019 drafttopic taxonomy). One row per sample_page_full window.

One row per (logging row, restriction type) for log_type protect/stable. is_opening rows set (restriction_type, level, expiry); is_closing rows (unprotect/reset) clear the page. page_id via api_logpage > api_pageid > associated_rev_id > title (resolution_method). params_era documents which parser produced the row; expiry NULL with is_indefinite=false means the expiry token could not be parsed (see expiry_raw).

enwiki protection log as returned by the MediaWiki API (fetch-protection-events/fetch_protection_log.py, pulled 2026-05-06). Joined to logging on log_id to recover page ids (logging.log_page is NULL). api_logpage/api_pageid NULL where the API returned 0.
Verbatim copy of logging rows with log_type IN (protect, stable), so later scripts never touch logging again.

Protection spells per (page_id, restriction_type) replayed from analysis.protect_event. scheduled_expiry is the admin-chosen expiry (RD clock); actual_end_ts = min(next boundary, expiry), NULL while open at 2026-04-01. close_reason: modified (same type re-set), dropped (type absent from the next protect/modify row), unprotected, expired, open. Page moves not stitched (page_id already survives moves for api_logpage-resolved rows).
Full-population staged RFPP intent-v2 candidates for db-auditing issue #1. Proposed values and explicit uncertainty, not applied automatically by this script.

Requests for Page Protection parsed from Wikipedia:Requests for page protection archives (fetch-protection-events/fetch_rfpp.py); rebuilt by load_rfpp_postgres.py. outcome=granted|denied|other|unparsed; page_id/actor ids resolved against the 2026-04-01 dump.
Immutable full RFPP snapshot before issue #1 intent-v2 repair, 2026-10-10. Includes raw fields and original classifications/linkage. Retain for rollback and historical analyses.

Page-window sample (sql/20_sample_page.sql, mode = see column). One row per page-window; arms granted / denied / control. admin_ts = RFPP decision (controls: the matched request's decision, pseudo-anchor); window = admin_ts +- 90 d; pull = [window_start - 30 d, window_end + 84 d]. expiry_anchor = scheduled expiry (granted) or a pseudo-expiry (median granted duration by requested level x year) for denied / control (expiry_is_pseudo). elig_level_code: 0 none 1 autoconfirmed 2 extendedconfirmed 3 templateeditor 4 sysop (LEVEL_CODE of src/stats.jl).

Page-window sample (sql/20_sample_page.sql, mode = see column). One row per page-window; arms granted / denied / control. admin_ts = RFPP decision (controls: the matched request's decision, pseudo-anchor); window = admin_ts +- 90 d; pull = [window_start - 30 d, window_end + 84 d]. expiry_anchor = scheduled expiry (granted) or a pseudo-expiry (median granted duration by requested level x year) for denied / control (expiry_is_pseudo). elig_level_code: 0 none 1 autoconfirmed 2 extendedconfirmed 3 templateeditor 4 sysop (LEVEL_CODE of src/stats.jl).

columns.sql: SELECT table_schema,table_name,column_name,data_type,is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema IN ('public','analysis') AND table_name IN ('page','actor','revision','logging','page_restrictions','protected_titles','protect_event','protection_episode','rfpp_request','protect_log_api','sample_request_full','sample_page_full') ORDER BY table_schema,table_name,ordinal_position

provenance_tables.sql: SELECT table_schema,table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') AND table_name ~ '(manifest|load|source|provenance|run|coverage|checkpoint|etl)' ORDER BY 1,2

active_work.sql: SELECT application_name,state,wait_event_type,wait_event,count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname=current_database() GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1,2
